title: She Leads
tagline: Where every woman is a leader
venue: Glendale International School, Oud Metha, Dubai
summary: A morning on mastering public speaking and leadership skills, learning from the experts, with a panel discussion and the Division C Director as chief guest.

lineup.name: Prathiba Leo
lineup.note: Business Communication Coach and TEDx speaker

story: On a Sunday morning in September 2025, Talk-Masters filled a hall at Glendale International School for She Leads, a morning built on one idea: every woman is a leader. Members, guests and their families came from all walks of life.

The Division C Director, DTM Deewee Alcasoas, opened with “Why Toastmasters?”. TM Shavonda followed with “Time to Charge Up”, and “The Career Pivot Playbook” turned to reinvention with purpose and power.

At the heart of the morning, Prathiba Leo moderated a panel with Tarannum Sheikh, Vibha Talati and Sangita Mishra: a conversation people still talk about. The audience took the microphone too, and the morning closed with TM Edwin's address and a plant for everyone who took the stage.

title: CareerNova
tagline: A career workshop for professionals who've been stuck too long
venue: Glendale International School, Oud Metha, Dubai
summary: A morning of seven talks on the next step in a career: CVs that get read, selling yourself, building a business of your own and the money habits behind it.
story: CareerNova brought a full hall together on a Sunday morning in June 2025, for professionals ready for their next move. Emcees Hadi and Geeta kept the programme moving from nine until one.

Edwin, then Vice President Membership, opened the day. Seven speakers followed, each with one practical idea: how HR reads a CV, how AI can tailor one for screening software, how to sell yourself, and how to start thinking like a business owner.
For some, the morning was a beginning. Afnas Pareed found his way to Talk-Masters that day, and Prathiba Leo, who gave the masterclass on selling yourself, decided to join within two minutes.
